note: Threat-evidence backfill: real conformance test at crates/chio-conformance/tests/threats/passkey_credential_theft.rs imports chio_custody_hw::{InMemoryPasskeyNonceStore, PasskeyNonceStore, RecordOutcome} and exercises the production per-credential nonce-store replay-detection surface. The deny-asserting arm presents the SAME (credential_id, challenge_nonce) pair twice: first call records RecordOutcome::Fresh; second call records RecordOutcome::Replayed. The issuer translates Replayed into CustodyError::ReplayDetected at urn:chio:error:custody:replay-detected. A counter-vector arm exercises distinct credential_ids with the same nonce string to confirm replay detection is keyed on the pair and does not over-reject unrelated credentials. The chio-custody-hw integration tests (replay_resistance.rs, revocation_cascade.rs, end_to_end.rs) are pinned as a supplementary regression net. Header documents the revert-to-prove-it-fails recipe (replace the duplicate-detection return with Ok(RecordOutcome::Fresh) in InMemoryPasskeyNonceStore::record_if_fresh).
